title: Bad weather hampers Indonesia ferry rescue, dozens still missing
summary: Indonesian rescuers brought ashore on Tuesday nearly two dozen survivors from a passenger ship that capsized off Java island at the weekend, their evacuation delayed by bad weather, officials said.
